from datetime import datetime
from typing import Annotated, ClassVar

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, Path, Query, status
from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field

router = APIRouter(prefix="/w/{workspace_id}/leads", tags=["leads"])


class LeadIn(BaseModel):
    """TODO: summary.

    \f
    Attributes:
        model_config: Pydantic model configuration.
        MAX_COMMENT (ClassVar[int]): TODO: description.
        name (str): Client name from the form.
        phone (Annotated[str, Field(description="Phone in any format")]): Phone in any format.
        comment (str | None): TODO: description. Defaults to `None`.
    """

    model_config = ConfigDict(frozen=True, extra="forbid")

    MAX_COMMENT: ClassVar[int] = 2000
    name: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=120, description="Client name from the form")
    phone: Annotated[str, Field(description="Phone in any format")]
    comment: str | None = None


class LeadOut(BaseModel):
    """TODO: summary.

    \f
    Attributes:
        id (int): Lead number inside the workspace.
        status (str): TODO: description.
        created_at (datetime): TODO: description.
        is_new (bool): TODO: description. Read-only.
    """

    id: int = Field(description="Lead number inside the workspace")
    status: str
    created_at: datetime

    @property
    def is_new(self) -> bool:
        return self.status == "new"


class Session:
    """TODO: summary."""

    def now(self) -> datetime:
        """TODO: summary.

        Returns:
            datetime: TODO: description.
        """
        return datetime.now().astimezone()


@router.get("/{lead_id}")
async def get_lead(
    workspace_id: Annotated[int, Path(description="Workspace id")],
    lead_id: Annotated[int, Path(ge=1, description="Lead number")],
    session: Annotated[Session, Depends()],
    *,
    with_history: Annotated[bool, Query(description="Include lead events")] = False,
) -> LeadOut:
    """TODO: summary.

    \f
    Args:
        workspace_id (Annotated[int, Path(description="Workspace id")]): Workspace id.
        lead_id (Annotated[int, Path(ge=1, description="Lead number")]): Lead number.
        session (Annotated[Session, Depends()]): TODO: description.
        with_history (Annotated[bool, Query(description="Include lead events")]): Include lead
            events. Defaults to `False`.

    Returns:
        LeadOut: TODO: description.

    Raises:
        HTTPException: TODO: description.
    """
    if lead_id > workspace_id * 1000:
        raise HTTPException(status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, "lead not found")
    return LeadOut(id=lead_id, status="new" if with_history else "taken", created_at=session.now())


@router.post("", status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED)
async def create_lead(workspace_id: int, body: LeadIn) -> LeadOut:
    """TODO: summary.

    \f
    Args:
        workspace_id (int): TODO: description.
        body (LeadIn): TODO: description.

    Returns:
        LeadOut: TODO: description.
    """
    return LeadOut(id=workspace_id, status=body.name, created_at=datetime.now().astimezone())


@router.delete("/{lead_id}", status_code=status.HTTP_204_NO_CONTENT)
async def delete_lead(lead_id: int) -> None:
    """TODO: summary.

    \f
    Args:
        lead_id (int): TODO: description.
    """
    del lead_id
